verdict.rationale: Svelte is a client-side UI framework and compiler. It has no hosted account or API service that could issue credentials, so scoped agent credentials are a category error for this kind of product. Its MCP server runs locally over stdio and serves documentation and code analysis. The "-s [scope]" flag in the MCP setup command is a Claude configuration scope, not a credential scope, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
